title: 1 Transforming Piece vs Martin
summary: Player has only a king and one transforming piece against Martin's full army. The piece changes type each time it moves: pawn -> knight -> bishop -> rook -> queen -> pawn ...
rules: Player (White): Ke1 + transforming piece starting as a pawn on e2. Martin (Black): full army.
Each time the transforming piece moves, after the move it becomes the next type in the cycle pawn -> knight -> bishop -> rook -> queen -> pawn.
Moving the king instead does not advance the cycle.
Pawns may stand on the back rank in this variant (so a pawn-form on rank 1 is legal).
